deduplicate_match_id.description: Drop duplicate match IDs, keeping latest occurrence

valid_5v5_distinct_heroes.description: Requires exactly 5 distinct non-zero hero IDs per team (filters leavers/incomplete drafts)

cross_team_overlap.description: Requires 0 overlapping heroes between Radiant and Dire

null_metadata_check.description: Requires non-null patch version and non-null winner boolean
